_about: Premium grade presets for look.preset (lib/premium.mjs gradePreset). curves = 5-point tone tables per channel (input 0, .25, .5, .75, 1 -> output), an SVG feComponentTransfer, i.e. a 1D LUT per channel. keep = selective colour (mask alpha = r*R + g*G + b*B + offset). css runs after the SVG filter. Any look.* key on the style overrides the preset's vignette/grain/tint.

belmar-teal.about: Prestige (Belmar look): teal shadows (#0E3A40), warm orange highlights (#FFC48A), contrast +12, sat 1.12, blacks lifted ~2%, skin natural

noir-film.about: Noir: noir-gold with a highlight knee (white hair keeps texture) and slightly lifted blacks; skin mono, gold kept

luxe-warm.about: lifted blacks, warm highlights, slight teal in the shadows; rich but soft

editorial-clean.about: bright, low saturation, crisp: magazine daylight

noir-gold.about: black and white with gold/amber accents kept (jewellery, lamps, logos in gold); skin goes mono

empire-noir.about: Empire (Iman Gadzhi look): crushed blacks to #08080C, punchy contrast, cool teal shadows, warm-neutral skin, sat 1.12; dark and expensive
